business_summary: China Everbright Environment Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides environmental solutions worldwide. The company's Environmental Energy Project Construction and Operation segment constructs and operates food and kitchen waste treatment, leachate and fecal treatment, sludge treatment and disposal, fly ash landfill, medical waste, and solid waste treatment projects, as well as waste-to-energy and methane-to-energy plants. It also provides integrated urban, waste sorting, technical consultancy and engineering design, renewable resources utilization, and sanitation operation services. Its Greentech Project Construction and Operation segment constructs and operates integrated biomass utilization, hazardous and solid waste treatment, and solar energy and wind power projects, as well as offers environmental remediation services. The company's Environmental Water Project Construction and Operation segment constructs, upgrades, and operates wastewater treatment plants; water supply and reusable water treatment plants; and sponge city construction, sludge treatment and disposal, leachate treatment, river-basin ecological restoration, and wastewater source heat pump projects. It also researches and develops water environment technologies and engineering projects. Its Others segment conducts environmental protection technology research and development projects; provides environmental related technological, and protection project equipment construction and installation services; designs environmental protection projects; and sells related equipment. It also collects and treats municipal wastes by mechanical and biological technology; and manufactures environmental protection equipment. The company was formerly known as China Everbright International Limited and changed its name to China Everbright Environment Group Limited in September 2020. China Everbright Environment Group Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Everbright Environment Group Limited는 전 세계적으로 환경 솔루션을 제공합니다. 회사의 환경 에너지 프로젝트 건설 및 운영 부문은 음식 및 주방 폐기물 처리, 침출수 및 배설물 처리, 슬러지 처리 및 폐기, 비산재 매립, 의료 폐기물, 고형 폐기물 처리 프로젝트는 물론 폐기물 에너지화 및 메탄 에너지화 플랜트를 건설 및 운영합니다. 또한 통합 도시, 폐기물 분류, 기술 컨설팅 및 엔지니어링 설계, 재생 가능 자원 활용 및 위생 운영 서비스를 제공합니다. Greentech 프로젝트 건설 및 운영 부문은 통합 바이오매스 활용, 위험 및 고형 폐기물 처리, 태양 에너지 및 풍력 발전 프로젝트를 건설 및 운영할 뿐만 아니라 환경 개선 서비스도 제공합니다. 회사의 환경 수자원 프로젝트 건설 및 운영 부문은 폐수 처리장을 건설, 업그레이드 및 운영합니다. 물 공급 및 재사용 가능한 물 처리 시설; 해면도시 건설, 슬러지 처리 및 처리, 침출수 처리, 하천유역 생태복원, 폐수원 히트펌프 사업 등
